execution.description: Ran suite v1's cited checks for battery to produce the first coverage report.

expected: Every check suite v1 cites runs and reports PASS or FAIL.
observed: The first run, in the development-only environment, left most checks NOT_RUN because the Challenge's dependency groups were absent. Rerun with battery's groups, all eight vectors passed.
keep: NOT_RUN is reported as NOT_RUN and never counted as a pass.
change: Each Challenge declares the dependency groups its checks need; the suite records them per Challenge.
